lines.zh: 我摆尾，绿松色的条纹一晃。
lines.en: I flick my tail and the turquoise stripes blur.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底游，鳍扫起细沙。
lines.en: I swim low over the bed, my fins lifting fine sand.

lines.zh: 逆流时我贴着石头，一点一点挪。
lines.en: Against the current I hug the stones and inch forward.

lines.zh: 转过那块石头，前面水更凉。
lines.en: Around that stone the water turns colder.

lines.zh: 我穿过水草，鳞片挂了一点绿。
lines.en: I pass through the weeds and a little green clings to my scales.

lines.zh: 绿松条纹随着尾巴一开一合。
lines.en: The turquoise stripes open and close with every tailbeat.

lines.zh: 游到浅处，我的背露出水面。
lines.en: Near the shallows my back breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈，把水面搅出小漩涡。
lines.en: I circle and stir a small whirlpool on the surface.

lines.zh: 这块河床的每道缝我都钻过。
lines.en: I have squeezed through every crack in this riverbed.

lines.zh: 我贴着同伴游，条纹看起来更多。
lines.en: I swim beside my fellows, and the stripes seem to multiply.

lines.zh: 我一下子窜出去，又停住。
lines.en: I dart forward, then stop dead.

lines.zh: 水草缠住鳍，我甩了两下才脱开。
lines.en: Weeds snag my fin, and two shakes free me.

lines.zh: 我浮到水面，看上面的光。
lines.en: I rise to the surface to look at the light above.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，沙上留下一道线。
lines.en: Where I pass, a thin line is left in the sand.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，钻进水草丛。
lines.en: One flick and I'm in the weeds.

lines.zh: 水底的沙很细，我贴着走。
lines.en: Fine sand below; I skim along it.

lines.zh: 我停在石头旁，只动鳍。
lines.en: I hold by a stone and move only my fins.

lines.zh: 腮盖一开一合，把凉水滤过去。
lines.en: My gill covers open and shut, sifting the cold water.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，假装是块绿石头。
lines.en: I stay perfectly still, pretending to be a green stone.

lines.zh: 水面上有影子，我抬头看。
lines.en: A shadow crosses the surface and I look up.

lines.zh: 我数着水的波纹，越数越慢。
lines.en: I count the ripples, and my counting slows.

lines.zh: 太阳照进水里，绿松色更亮了。
lines.en: Sunlight enters the water and my turquoise brightens.

lines.zh: 我轻轻咬着水草，其实不饿。
lines.en: I nibble the weeds, though I am not hungry.

lines.zh: 我躲在一片宽叶下面。
lines.en: I hide beneath a single broad leaf.

lines.zh: 水里很静，只有我自己的呼吸。
lines.en: The water is quiet, save for my own breathing.

lines.zh: 我横着卡进石缝，只露出尾鳍。
lines.en: I wedge sideways into a crack, leaving only my tail out.

lines.zh: 我吐出一串小泡，它们撞在石头上。
lines.en: I release a string of bubbles and they break on stone.

lines.zh: 我等一群小鱼先过去。
lines.en: I wait for a shoal of smaller fish to pass.

lines.zh: 这里的水温刚好，我不想动。
lines.en: The water here is just right, and I do not want to move.

lines.zh: 我在水底打了个盹，鳍还在摆。
lines.en: I doze on the bottom while my fins keep working.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，你的影子先下水。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, and your shadow enters the water first.

lines.zh: 我隔着水看你，你的脸是歪的。
lines.en: I see you through the water, and your face is bent.

lines.zh: 你伸手进来，我往后退了一点。
lines.en: Your hand comes in, so I back off a little.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进浅水，水浑了。
lines.en: Your boots step into the shallows and the water clouds.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，那里有东西在动。
lines.en: I watch your hand, where something is moving.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰，我就看见你的眼睛。
lines.en: You bend down and I can see your eyes.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但你不像鱼。
lines.en: I do not know you, but you are no fish.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我才游到你的影子边上。
lines.en: You crouch, and only then do I swim to your shadow.

lines.zh: 水面把你的影子撕成几块。
lines.en: The surface tears your shadow into pieces.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边绕了一圈，又走了。
lines.en: I circle your feet once and then leave.

lines.zh: 疼，我一甩尾就窜出去。
lines.en: It hurts, and one tail flick sends me away.

lines.zh: 我的鳞掉了一片，水里有血味。
lines.en: A scale comes off and blood taints the water.

lines.zh: 我撞在石头上，慌得找不到路。
lines.en: I hit a stone and panic, unable to find a way.

lines.zh: 你的手掌合上，我鳞片全是滑的。
lines.en: Your palm closes, but every scale of mine is slick.

lines.zh: 这一下让我整条鱼都僵了。
lines.en: The blow stiffens my whole body.

lines.zh: 我往深处钻，越深越暗。
lines.en: I dive deeper, and the deeper it gets, the darker.

lines.zh: 我的鳍破了，游起来歪。
lines.en: My fin is torn, so I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 水变红了，我得离开这里。
lines.en: The water turns red, so I must leave.

lines.zh: 我只有两点血，禁不住第二下。
lines.en: I have two hearts only and cannot take another hit.

lines.zh: 我躲在石头后面，屏住鳍。
lines.en: I hide behind a stone and still my fins.

lines.zh: 水上落下的碎屑，是给我的吗。
lines.en: Those crumbs falling on the water, are they for me?

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，但我可以看看。
lines.en: I do not eat bread, but I can look.

lines.zh: 你撒的东西散开，我闻到味。
lines.en: What you scatter spreads out, and I catch the smell.

lines.zh: 我跟着那些小颗粒游。
lines.en: I follow those small grains as they sink.

lines.zh: 红色的东西沉下来，我咬了一口。
lines.en: Something red sinks down and I take a bite.

lines.zh: 你再多撒一点，我就不走。
lines.en: Scatter a little more and I will stay.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，又合上，什么也没吃到。
lines.en: I open my mouth, close it, and taste nothing.

lines.zh: 这味道新鲜，不像水草。
lines.en: This tastes fresh, not like weeds at all.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的手游，只想要更多。
lines.en: I swim against your hand and want only more.

lines.zh: 你收起袋子，我就散开了。
lines.en: You put the bag away, and I drift off.

lines.zh: 水花一炸，我被掀得贴住河床。
lines.en: The splash bursts and I am pressed against the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我的鳍碰到你的腿，滑走了。
lines.en: My fin brushes your leg and slips away.

lines.zh: 别挤，这里水本来就不宽。
lines.en: Do not crowd; the water here is narrow already.

lines.zh: 我被水波推着撞上石头。
lines.en: The wash shoves me into a stone.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，鳞片掉了两片。
lines.en: We collide and two scales come loose.

lines.zh: 我绕开你的靴子，水花溅起来。
lines.en: I swerve around your boots and water splashes up.

lines.zh: 你的影子压下来，我钻到水草里。
lines.en: Your shadow falls, and I dive into the weeds.

lines.zh: 撞一下我就晕，我太小了。
lines.en: One bump dazes me; I am that small.

lines.zh: 你的手指合拢，我从缝里溜出去。
lines.en: Your fingers close, and I slide out through the gap.

lines.zh: 你往后退，水把我推向前。
lines.en: You step back and the water carries me forward.

lines.zh: 我们绕着圈游，条纹转成一片。
lines.en: We circle each other until the stripes blur into one.

lines.zh: 她比我亮，我跟在后面。
lines.en: She is brighter than me, so I follow behind.

lines.zh: 我们在水草里并排，谁也不动。
lines.en: We lie side by side in the weeds and neither moves.

lines.zh: 过几天，这片水里会有小的。
lines.en: In a few days there will be small ones in this water.

lines.zh: 我用鳍碰了碰她的鳍。
lines.en: I touch my fin to hers.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我们会散开。
lines.en: Do not come too close, or we scatter.

lines.zh: 她把水搅浑，我就找不到她了。
lines.en: She muddies the water and I lose her.

lines.zh: 我们一起往深处游。
lines.en: We swim down into the deeper water together.

lines.zh: 这块石头下是我们的地方。
lines.en: The space under this stone belongs to us.

lines.zh: 她走了，我还在原地转圈。
lines.en: She leaves, and I keep circling the same spot.

lines.zh: 水底有个亮的东西，我去啄。
lines.en: Something bright lies on the bottom, and I peck at it.

lines.zh: 我咬了一下，是块玻璃碎片。
lines.en: I bite down and find a shard of glass.

lines.zh: 它沉下来，我就用嘴顶着。
lines.en: It sinks, so I prop it on my snout.

lines.zh: 我推着它走，走两步就掉了。
lines.en: I push it along, and it drops after two strokes.

lines.zh: 这东西不能吃，我还含着。
lines.en: This is not food, yet I keep holding it.

lines.zh: 我把它藏在石头缝里。
lines.en: I tuck it into a crack between stones.

lines.zh: 我含不住，太大了。
lines.en: I cannot hold it; it is too big.

lines.zh: 那点反光晃眼，我还以为是鳞片。
lines.en: That flicker dazzled me; I took it for a scale.

lines.zh: 我用嘴翻它，翻过来又翻回去。
lines.en: I flip it with my mouth, over and over.

lines.zh: 它掉进泥里，我找了很久。
lines.en: It falls into the mud and I search a long time.

lines.zh: 前面有东西在动，我先停下。
lines.en: Something moves ahead, so I stop first.

lines.zh: 那是鱼还是叶子，我看不清。
lines.en: Is that a fish or a leaf? I cannot tell.

lines.zh: 它比我小，我可以去碰一下。
lines.en: It is smaller than me, so I can nudge it.

lines.zh: 有影子压下来，我想跑。
lines.en: A shadow descends and I want to flee.

lines.zh: 我盯住了那只小虾。
lines.en: I fix on that little shrimp.

lines.zh: 我把身子摆成一条线，准备掉头。
lines.en: I line my body up straight, ready to turn and flee.

lines.zh: 水里那股血味，我想躲远。
lines.en: That taste of blood in the water makes me want distance.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那条更小的鱼。
lines.en: I lock onto the smaller fish.

lines.zh: 上面有东西在等我，我不上去。
lines.en: Something waits above, and I will not rise.

lines.zh: 它跑了，我追了几寸就停。
lines.en: It bolts, and I chase a few inches then stop.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，随时准备掉头。
lines.en: I turn side-on, ready to bolt at any moment.

lines.zh: 它再动一下，我就窜出去。
lines.en: One more move from it and I dart away.

lines.zh: 我绕到它身后，水声很轻。
lines.en: I circle behind it, making almost no sound.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，尾巴却在发抖。
lines.en: I stare at it while my tail trembles.

lines.zh: 别转过来，我不想被看见。
lines.en: Do not turn around; I do not want to be seen.

lines.zh: 我贴着石头，等它游近。
lines.en: I press to the stone and wait for it to come near.

lines.zh: 它挡住了我的路，我绕开。
lines.en: It blocks my way, so I go around.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面，那里有钩子吗。
lines.en: I watch the surface, wondering if a hook is there.

lines.zh: 我把鳍收紧，让自己更小。
lines.en: I tuck my fins in to make myself smaller.

lines.zh: 它靠近，我退半寸，再退半寸。
lines.en: It comes closer, and I retreat half an inch, then another.

lines.zh: 我撞了它一下，自己先晕了。
lines.en: I ram it and end up dazed myself.

lines.zh: 我的嘴很小，咬不动。
lines.en: My mouth is tiny and cannot bite through.

lines.zh: 我用力甩尾，水花打在它身上。
lines.en: I whip my tail and spray water over it.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也翻了身。
lines.en: That blow tipped me over as well.

lines.zh: 别抢我的水草，我咬你。
lines.en: Do not take my weeds; I will bite you.

lines.zh: 我冲过去，半路改了方向。
lines.en: I charge, then change direction halfway.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍，又松开了。
lines.en: I bite its fin, then let go.

lines.zh: 我只有两点血，打不了架。
lines.en: I have two hearts only, so I cannot really fight.

lines.zh: 推它一下，它就让开了。
lines.en: One shove and it moves aside.

lines.zh: 我撞完就逃，逃得比它快。
lines.en: I strike and flee, and I flee faster than it.

lines.zh: 我在水里睁开眼，四周都是绿。
lines.en: I open my eyes underwater, surrounded by green.

lines.zh: 水面上的光很亮，我先躲开。
lines.en: The light on the surface is bright, so I shy away.

lines.zh: 这里有水草，我就在这住下。
lines.en: There are weeds here, so I will settle.

lines.zh: 我摆了两下尾巴，确认能游。
lines.en: I flick my tail twice to be sure I can swim.

lines.zh: 同伴在附近，我们成群。
lines.en: My fellows are nearby, and we school together.

lines.zh: 水很浅，我差点被冲上岸。
lines.en: The water is shallow and almost washes me ashore.

lines.zh: 我睁眼就在这片水草里，谁也不认识。
lines.en: I wake among these weeds knowing nobody at all.

lines.zh: 第一口水很凉，我很喜欢。
lines.en: The first mouthful is cold, and I like it.

lines.zh: 有鱼在看我，我也看回去。
lines.en: A fish is watching me, so I watch back.

lines.zh: 我钻进石缝，先把身子藏好。
lines.en: I slip into a crack and hide myself first.

lines.zh: 热水烫得我直往上蹿。
lines.en: The boiling water sends me shooting upward.

lines.zh: 我摔在干地上，腮一张一合。
lines.en: I land on dry ground, my gills opening and closing.

lines.zh: 水没了，我在地上弹了两下。
lines.en: The water is gone and I flop twice on the ground.

lines.zh: 炸得水都掀起来，我翻了白肚。
lines.en: The blast lifts the water and I turn belly-up.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西穿进水里，扎中了我。
lines.en: Something sharp cuts into the water and pierces me.

lines.zh: 光一照，我连方向都忘了。
lines.en: The light hits me and I forget which way is which.

lines.zh: 水里没吃的，我的肚子贴着骨头。
lines.en: With nothing to eat, my belly presses to my bones.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水过来，我尾巴先僵了。
lines.en: The lightning travels through water and my tail stiffens first.

lines.zh: 水没了，我掉进黑里，一直掉。
lines.en: The water ends and I fall into the dark, falling still.
